scope: The Great Lavra Bell Tower in Kyiv around the July 2013 Qualla photographs, including the yellow masonry base, three white-columned upper stages, open belfries, gilded dome, lantern and cross. Other monastery buildings and surrounding walls are separate structures.

originalReview.notes: The complete tower image shows the yellow lower masonry, white colonnaded diminishing stages, open bell windows, gilded dome, small lantern and cross.
The close view shows the gilded eagle capital against white classical ornament. The relief will be simplified at medium-fi scale.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed both Qualla originals first and bound their exact native bytes, photographer identity and first-person CC0 releases. Both were taken on 21 July 2013. No supplemental imagery was used.
